Use your built-in image generation tool to create ONE image. A new painting: a very wide view across an industrial landscape on the Rhine: a long rail line with tank wagons and a sweep of colourful pipelines running from left to right across the whole picture, a chemical plant and cranes in the distance, Monet-like sky and water. Strong horizontal flow from left to right, like a path or a journey. The upper two thirds calm, airy and light (text sits over it).

Style: a modern, abstract impressionist painting in the spirit of Claude Monet's Water Lilies and Impression Sunrise. Brushwork: thin, fluid, translucent paint; small loose brush dabs and soft washes laid side by side; soft, airy, luminous surface, almost as light as watercolour. STRICTLY NO palette knife, NO Spachtel technique, NO thick impasto, NO heavy paint ridges or relief texture, NO scratchy streaks. Forms are simplified into calm colour planes but stay clearly recognisable: containers, cranes, ships, tanks, racks must read at a glance as what they are, with clean simple silhouettes. Palette rich and colourful but calm and harmonious: cobalt and ultramarine blue, violet and lilac, viridian and emerald green, rose pink, cadmium orange and warm gold, a few coral accents. Bright and luminous. NOT foggy, NOT grey, NOT beige, NOT sepia, NOT photographic. Gallery quality, modern. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no signature, no frame, no border, no people in focus. Landscape format, 1536x1024 (the largest landscape size).

Then save the generated image as a PNG file at exactly this path: /Users/richardwaldow/bing_richard/10_DemandMatch_Atelier-monet/_source-art/monet/pipeline.png
Do not write or change any other file. Do not write code. If the result looks like thick palette-knife impasto, or turns grey, beige or sepia, generate again.
